meta.title: RU in-house fully loaded cost per role and grade, 2026
meta.purpose: Machine-usable rate card for the in-house (ТМК++/ДИАЙПИ) cost base of the should-cost cockpit.
meta.geography: RU; workplace default is Moscow Class B. Regional office cost is not modeled.

currency.policy: RUB only. No FX conversion is applied anywhere in this file. All hourly values are RUB per productive hour.

meta.basis_chain: net take-home monthly -> gross monthly -> employer payroll (gross + statutory contributions) -> +15% overheads -> + office/hardware/software -> per productive hour

provenance.licence_note: Market medians and statutory rates are cited, not redistributed. Research files are the project's source of record. ISBSG data is not redistributed here.

confidence_legend.High: Primary source or official statistic states the value directly, and the role/grade mapping is the source anchor or a direct statutory/arithmetic step.
confidence_legend.Medium: Derived from High-confidence inputs by an explicit formula, or a blend of two sourced roles, or a grade extrapolation from the anchor.
confidence_legend.Low: Source is a blog aggregation, a small/biased sample, or a bucket that mixes roles.
confidence_legend.Proxy: No defensible public benchmark. Built from sourced components and a documented planning assumption; must be replaced with an offer or internal grade card before pricing.

ndfl.note: NDFL is an employee tax. The model solves gross from net, then applies employer contributions to gross.

employer_contributions.formula: contributions = 30% x min(annual gross, 2,979,000) + 15.1% x max(0, annual gross - 2,979,000)
employer_contributions.note: The task brief says 'x1.30 employer insurance'. The exact capped formula is used instead of a flat 1.30; the effective multiplier is shown per row. Injury contributions 0.2-8.5% are NOT included; add them from the employer's risk class.

derivation_policy.overhead_source: research/10_product_concept.md section 2-L4: social package, training, management 10-18%; 1.15 is the midpoint used by the project. Not a market benchmark.

workplace_components_month_rub.office_derivation: Moscow Class B rent 22,423 + OPEX 6,000 RUB/m2/year at 10 m2 = 284,230 RUB/year = 23,686 RUB/month (07 sections 5.1, 5.4).
workplace_components_month_rub.hardware_derivation: Planning value 6,250 RUB/month inside the 4,932-8,265 derived from 177,539-297,539 RUB per 36 months (07 sections 5.2, 5.4).
workplace_components_month_rub.software_derivation: 100,000 RUB/developer/year = 8,333 RUB/month, inside the 50,000-150,000 proxy range (07 section 5.3); no single public source.

grade_ratios.source: research/07 section 1.3, derived from the RUIT Union ladder (junior 110k, middle 200k, senior 300k, lead 380k net).
grade_ratios.note: Derived planning aid, not a sourced salary table. Applied to each role's anchor grade.

derivation_policy.rounding: Net is rounded to the nearest 100 RUB. Gross, contributions, overhead and workplace lines are computed from that rounded net; each output is rounded to the nearest RUB. Sums may differ by +/-2 RUB from unrounded arithmetic.
derivation_policy.regional_policy: The office cost is Moscow Class B. For a non-Moscow employer, replace the office line with a local lease quote and mark the result Proxy. 07 section 5.1 has no sourced regional office figure.
derivation_policy.payroll_only_vs_full: employer_payroll_month is payroll only. fully_loaded_month adds 15% overheads and the three workplace lines.
derivation_policy.workplace_fixed_cost_note: Office, hardware and software are fixed monthly amounts (38,269 RUB). At junior salaries they raise the fully-loaded multiplier above 2x net; at senior salaries the multiplier falls. Do not use a single '1.5x net' rule across grades.

recalibration.procedure: Replace base_net_month with the median of the client's own offers for the same role and anchor grade, keep anchor_grade and grade_ratios, rerun the chain. If the offer is gross, convert to net with the NDFL brackets before entering it; do not mix net and gross.
recalibration.minimum_sample: 10-20 offers per role/grade; record offer date, city, basis (net/gross), and source.

confidence.High: Primary source or official statistic states the value directly, and the role/grade mapping is the source anchor or a direct statutory/arithmetic step.
confidence.Medium: Derived from High-confidence inputs by an explicit formula, or a blend of two sourced roles, or a grade extrapolation from the anchor.
confidence.Low: Source is a blog aggregation, a small/biased sample, or a bucket that mixes roles.
confidence.Proxy: No defensible public benchmark. Built from sourced components and a documented planning assumption; must be replaced with an offer or internal grade card before pricing.
